data.content: Which countries have the highest number of sampling sites in the dataset, and how many sites does each of the top 10 countries contain?

args.query: List the top 10 countries by number of sampling sites in the dataset, returning each country and the count of unique sampling sites, sorted by site count descending.

data.content:
The full results cropped to 5 rows:

            {"Country":{"0":"France","1":"Netherlands","2":"Germany","3":"Slovakia","4":"Sweden"},"SiteCount":{"0":4689,"1":3608,"2":1212,"3":453,"4":105}}

            Provide the user with a Markdown formatted table of the data and a textual summary.
            <summary>
            {"Country":{"count":10,"unique":10,"top":"France","freq":1,"mean":null,"std":null,"min":null,"25%":null,"50%":null,"75%":null,"max":null},"SiteCount":{"count":10.0,"unique":null,"top":null,"freq":null,"mean":1040.2,"std":1696.1851838104,"min":46.0,"25%":74.5,"50%":97.5,"75%":1022.25,"max":4689.0}}
            </summary>
            
            Always provide the following cypher query as code to the user
            ``` 
            MATCH (l:Site)
WHERE l.country IS NOT NULL
RETURN l.country AS Country, count(DISTINCT l.name) AS SiteCount
ORDER BY SiteCount DESC
LIMIT 10

            ```
            
            Always provide the Zenodo link `https://zenodo.org/records/14616124` of the docker container holding
